context.skin_label: Oversized editorial headline up top, footage as a lower third

video_prompt: A vertical thirty-second promotional video using a speed-run editorial format. The visual construction features an oversized editorial headline up top with a lower-third screen recording of the citation generator in action. At zero seconds, a clean hook screen appears. At five seconds, the video cuts to a real screen recording showing source details being typed into the tool. At sixteen seconds, the layout shifts to show output formatting. At twenty-three seconds, the video displays the call to action with the web address. The emotional angle focuses on the relief of finishing a reference list without formatting mistakes.

vo.text: Staring at a blank bibliography is frustrating.
Type your source details and watch references build.
All three styles generate at once so you can compare them.
Get the exact format you need.
No signup required to use it.
Build your references free at toolsrift.com/study/citation-generator.

on_screen.caption: APA 7, MLA 9, and Chicago styles build as you type.
on_screen.cta_tags: Free to use · No registration · Instant copy

editorial: Generating three different style formats simultaneously allows students to instantly check and compare references before copying them directly into their research papers.
